decisions.reason: Dietary supplement range builds on the firm's established offer and in-house R&D, so absorptive capacity supports learning and improvement.
Skin and hair dietary supplement builds on the firm's established offer and in-house R&D, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
Joint health dietary supplement builds on the firm's established offer and relates to existing knowledge, enabling learning and product refinement.
